description: TokenMonitor SessionStart hook — nudges to update the plugin/broker when a newer release is published (the broker does not auto-update)

hooks.command: sh -c 'for f in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:+$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/}hooks/session-start.js" hooks/session-start.js session-start.js; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec node "$f"; break; done; exit 0'
